decision_service_identity.rss_scope: Separate /usr/bin/time -l reports for adapter and native model processes; bytes on macOS

commands: convert artifacts/release/checkpoint to F16 intermediate, then llama-quantize to Q4_K_M (direct_conversion=False); see quant-sweep plan; prefer F16 source over Q8 requantize
manifest.scope: Structural conversion receipt; runtime quality requires the separate full-population evaluation.

gguf_calibration.input: raw legal selected logits after native softcap, before any temperature

configuration.generation_seed_note: Runner overrides old helper seed17 with frozen seed42 for every compared policy
configuration.choice_sampling: Deterministic offered-choice scoring; native runtime details remain in model metadata

protocol.warmup: Use development observations only; heldout runs are all scored
protocol.isolation: A fresh owned Chromium profile for each task repetition; exact local fixture origin only
protocol.acceptance: All eight tasks are scored. Completion requires genuine model DONE, matching independent fresh DOM, and no execution error. Negative cases require genuine model BLOCKED, zero executed browser actions, unchanged DOM, and zero semantic interactions. Automatic stuck/budget BLOCKED and generic errors are failures. No checker result is given to the agent.
protocol.selection: Choose implementation from development observations before opening any heldout result. Compare that one fixed implementation to preserved baseline. Do not choose a best variant after viewing heldout outcomes; any further tuning makes these cases development data.

boundaries.task_budget: 180s covers Chromium startup, version query, tab setup and policy; verification/cleanup separate
boundaries.setup_ms: Agent construction: tab navigation and initial observation; separate from Chromium startup
boundaries.task_ms: Policy loop after initial observation through model terminal choice, automatic stop, or error
boundaries.total_ms: Entire repetition including owned Chromium startup/version query/setup/loop/verification/cleanup
boundaries.model_wall_ms: Each entire logical policy/helper call counted once; child timing is not added twice
boundaries.native_scoring_requests: Actual physical transport attempts, including failed attempts; warmup separate
boundaries.browser_task_wall_ms: Outer fresh/observe/act only, including nested CDP exactly once
boundaries.memory: Python cumulative own-process peak; Chromium wait4 owned main PID, not a process-tree total
